purpose: Validate that the D7.3 canonical production catalog has stable identities, exact 1:1 matrix linkage, and a complete provenance chain without activating runtime or production execution.
source_of_truth: D7.3 canonical catalog plus its governed predecessors

identity_rules.catalog_item_id: cat_ plus first 16 lowercase hex characters of SHA-256(catalog_key UTF-8)
identity_rules.identity_hash: SHA-256 of canonical JSON for the catalog item excluding identity_hash, using UTF-8, sort_keys=true, compact separators, and trailing newline
identity_rules.stability: identity values must be recomputable and unchanged across repeated validation

provenance_chain: D4.4 canonical production orchestrator plan owner
